name: Fun Times at the Bibi Resort and Spa
source:
Marina and Marcello Forlani are the sibling design team behind the fashion label Forlani. But after their 2025 Milan collection is torn apart by critics, they’re in desperate need of a break. Luckily, an old friend offers the perfect escape: a stay at the luxurious Bibi Resort on the dreamy island of Fuente Grande.

Sun, style, and plenty of romance await. Between poolside cocktails, glittering soirées, and quiet walks along the beach, Marina and Marcello will meet an array of captivating women; each with her own charm, secrets, and stories.

Play as Marina (a lesbian woman) or Marcello (a straight man) as you explore paradise and chase the possibility of love. Will you find your perfect match in the island breeze?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4042480/Fun_Times_at_the_Bibi_Resort_and_Spa/]Steam[/url]]
